question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Shakuntala was __very amazed__ to see her name on the list.
solution:
The correct answer is: **astonished**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amazed"** means filled with great surprise or wonder. It is used to describe a feeling of being impressed or astounded. (आश्चर्यचकित)

 
 
• **Example:** She was amazed by the beauty of the sunset over the mountains.
 
 
 
• **"Astonished"** refers to being greatly surprised or shocked, often in a positive sense. It is a synonym for amazed but conveys a slightly stronger emotion. (चौंका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** He was astonished to find out that he had won the lottery.
 
 
 
• Hence, the more appropriate word to replace "amazed" in this context is **"astonished"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **astonished**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Worried** (चिंतित): Feeling anxious or concerned about something.

 
 
• **Example:** She was worried about her upcoming exams.
 
 
 
• **Accurate** (सटीक): Free from errors; correct or precise.
 
 
• **Example:** His calculations were accurate and reliable.
 
 
 
• **Swamped** (व्यस्त): Overwhelmed with too much work or tasks.
 
 
• **Example:** The team was swamped with deadlines and assignments.
 
 

3a:T67c,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**
